title: Master Your Game: How 5-Stop Hall-Effect Clutch Triggers with Hair-Trigger Mode Enhance Precision in Competitive Play.
summary: Unlock peak performance in competitive gaming with 5-stop Hall-Effect clutch triggers and hair-trigger mode controllers, designed for unmatched precisio...
body_text: That split-second advantage between landing the shot and watching the killcam often comes down to one thing: trigger response time. While opponents struggle with worn triggers and input lag, pro gamers master 5-stop Hall-Effect clutch triggers with hair-trigger mode gaming controllers to dominate the competition. In competitive gaming, milliseconds determine victory. Traditional triggers wear down, develop dead zones, and lose precision over thousands of matches. Turtle Beach Hall-Effect triggers eliminate these issues, delivering a consistent, lightning-fast response that gives serious players the edge they need. Whether you're climbing ranked ladders in first-person shooters or executing frame-perfect combos in fighting games, competitive gaming precision triggers transform how you play. This isn't just about faster shooting; it's about mastering every aspect of trigger control for peak performance. What Are 5-Stop Hall-Effect Clutch Triggers? The Science Behind Hall-Effect Sensor Technology Hall-Effect sensors detect magnetic field changes without physical contact, using electromagnetic induction discovered by physicist Edwin Hall in 1879. Unlike traditional analog triggers that rely on resistive contacts that wear down over time, Hall-Effect triggers have advantages that center on magnetic sensing that never degrades. When you press a Hall-Effect trigger, a magnet attached to the trigger moves closer to the sensor, changing the magnetic field strength. This creates a voltage signal proportional to trigger position, providing an incredibly precise, linear response without any physical contact between moving parts. According to the Melexis Hall-effect principle documentation, this contactless sensing eliminates wear-related degradation. Understanding the 5-Stop Functionality Gaming controller trigger customization reaches new heights with 5-stop clutch technology. Each "stop" represents a different trigger travel distance, allowing you to fine-tune trigger response for specific gaming scenarios: Stop 1: Ultra-short travel for rapid trigger response in competitive shooters Stop 2-3: Medium travel for balanced performance across game genres Stop 4-5: Full travel distance for racing games requiring precise throttle control This adjustability means one controller adapts to every game type, from hair-trigger FPS matches to analog-sensitive racing simulations. The Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded exemplifies this technology with its patented 5-stop Hall-Effect clutch triggers that competitive esports players depend on. Superior Benefits Over Traditional Triggers Hall-Effect sensors eliminate stick drift permanently because magnetic sensing requires no physical contact. Traditional potentiometer triggers develop dead zones and inconsistent responses as internal components wear down. Analog triggers for FPS games suffer from this degradation, but Hall-Effect technology maintains consistent calibration indefinitely. Game controller input accuracy improves dramatically with Hall-Effect sensors. While conventional triggers can lose accuracy over their lifespan due to mechanical wear, magnetic sensing maintains a precise response throughout millions of actuations without degradation. Understanding Hair-Trigger Mode Defining Hair-Trigger Functionality Hair-trigger mode reduces trigger travel distance to the minimum actuation point, typically around half the total travel distance. This allows triggers to register input and reset faster, creating significant advantages in rapid-fire scenarios. Hair-trigger mode benefits become immediately apparent in competitive scenarios. According to third-party modification data, professional gaming modifications can reduce trigger travel to as little as 1.5mm compared to standard 6-7mm travel distances, saving 4.5 times the distance and dramatically improving response times. The Impact on Reaction Time and Performance Professional esports players consider trigger stops crucial for competitive advantages because faster trigger actuation directly translates to performance improvements. Clutch triggers for esports provide measurable improvements in several key areas: Reduced input latency: Shorter travel distance means faster actuation and reset Increased fire rate: Enables higher sustained rates of fire in supported games Enhanced precision: Consistent, predictable trigger response improves accuracy Decreased fatigue: Less finger movement reduces strain during extended play sessions The Stealth Ultra incorporates these principles with adjustable trigger stops that modify throw distance on the fly, allowing instant adaptation between gaming scenarios without controller reconfiguration. Stealth Ultra Wireless Controller with Rapid Charge Dock View Product How These Features Enhance Precision in Competitive Play Real-World Benefits for Fast-Paced Shooters In first-person shooters, competitive play trigger enhancement provides tangible advantages during crucial engagements. Hair-trigger technology allows instant response and elimination of latency caused by physical movement, enabling faster shooting accuracy and precise movement control. Consider a competitive Valorant match where counter-strafing and quick-peeking determine round outcomes. Traditional triggers introduce additional input lag through mechanical actuation. Hall-Effect triggers eliminate this delay, allowing frame-perfect timing that can mean the difference between securing a kill or losing the duel. Gaming controller sensitivity tweaks become crucial for different weapon types. Sniper rifles benefit from full trigger travel for precise shot timing, while automatic weapons excel with hair-trigger settings for maximum fire rate. The Stealth Pivot offers this versatility with rotating control modules designed for different game genres. Fighting Game Applications Fighting games demand frame-perfect inputs, where hair-trigger mode gaming controllers excel. Complex combo execution requires consistent trigger timing. Hall-Effect sensors ensure every input register is identical, eliminating the execution inconsistency that ruins advanced techniques. The modular design philosophy extends to Turtle Beach's entire controller collection , where customizable trigger response adapts to fighting game requirements without hardware modifications. Improved Input Accuracy and Consistency Hall-Effect sensors provide a smooth, linear response that matches the input exactly, without dead zones or jitter affecting accuracy and performance. This game controller's input accuracy improvement becomes pronounced during extended gaming sessions when traditional triggers develop inconsistent response patterns. Professional-grade triggers maintain calibration across millions of actuations. While conventional triggers require recalibration or replacement after 6-12 months of intensive use, Hall-Effect technology delivers identical performance throughout the controller's entire lifespan. Why Pro Gamers Prefer Hall-Effect Triggers with Hair-Trigger Mode Durability and Reliability in Professional Settings Tactile microswitches rated at 5 million click lifecycles, combined with contactless Hall-Effect sensors, create controllers designed for professional longevity. Tournament play demands absolute reliability; controller failure during competition can eliminate months of preparation. Professional esports organizations invest in Turtle Beach Hall-Effect triggers because magnetic sensing technology cannot wear out or drift over time. Unlike potentiometer-based systems that develop dead zones and require constant adjustment, Hall-Effect sensors maintain factory specifications indefinitely. The Afterglow Wave demonstrates this durability focus with Hall-Effect thumbsticks and triggers designed for competitive reliability at an accessible price point. Customization Potential and Personalized Feel Advanced controllers like the Stealth Ultra offer comprehensive customization through dedicated software . Gaming controller trigger customization includes: Individual trigger sensitivity adjustment: Fine-tune actuation points for each trigger independently Dead zone configuration: Customize trigger response curves for different game requirements Profile storage: Save multiple configurations for instant switching between game types Real-time adjustment: Modify trigger behavior during gameplay without menu navigation This level of customization allows professional players to optimize controller response for specific games, opponents, or even individual maps within the same title. Tournament-Legal Performance Enhancement All competitive gaming precision triggers in Turtle Beach's professional lineup comply with major esports tournament regulations. Features like adjustable trigger stops and Hall-Effect sensors provide performance advantages without violating competition rules, giving players a legitimate edge over standard controllers. Note: Individual performance improvements may vary based on player skill level and game-specific mechanics. The benefits described represent optimal conditions with properly configured equipment. How to Maximize Your Performance with These Features Optimizing Hair-Trigger Settings by Genre Different game types require specific hair-trigger mode benefits optimization: First-Person Shooters: Set triggers to minimum travel distance for maximum fire rate. Configure separate profiles for different weapon classes; sniper rifles may benefit from slightly longer travel for precise shot timing. Racing Games: Use full trigger travel to access complete throttle and brake control ranges. The analog nature of Hall-Effect sensors provides superior vehicle control compared to digital trigger modes. Fighting Games: Medium trigger travel offers the best balance between rapid input and accidental activation prevention during complex combo sequences. The Rematch Core provides an excellent entry point for gamers exploring these optimization techniques without a premium controller investment. Integrating with Complete Gaming Setup Rapid trigger response controllers work best as part of a complete gaming ecosystem. Pairing Hall-Effect triggers with high-quality audio creates a comprehensive competitive advantage. The Stealth 700 Gen 3 headset complements precision triggers with spatial audio that helps identify enemy positions before they appear on screen. For professional-level setups, consider the complete Turtle Beach ecosystem: Controllers: Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded for modular flexibility Audio: Stealth Pro for tournament-grade sound Peripherals: Gaming keyboards with matching response characteristics Advanced Customization Techniques Professional players utilize gaming controller sensitivity tweaks to create microscopic advantages. Consider trigger curve modification, adjusting how trigger position translates to in-game action. Linear curves work best for racing, while exponential curves benefit shooting games by providing more precise aiming at lower trigger positions. Advanced users often configure trigger-specific dead zones. Setting small dead zones prevents accidental activation while ensuring immediate response once intentional input begins. This proves crucial in games where trigger discipline determines success. The Technology Behind the Performance Hall-Effect vs. Traditional Analog Systems Traditional analog triggers rely on electrical resistance changes through physical contact, causing component wear and drift development over time. Hall-Effect technology measures magnetic field strength without physical contact, eliminating wear-related degradation. The technical superiority becomes apparent through precision measurements. According to IEEE documentation on Hall sensors, Hall-Effect sensors maintain consistent performance without the mechanical degradation that affects traditional potentiometers over time. Future-Proofing Your Gaming Setup Advanced controllers are incorporating newer sensing technologies that build upon Hall-Effect principles. Turtle Beach's commitment to cutting-edge technology ensures its controllers remain competitive as gaming demands evolve. Professional flight simulation showcases this technology advancement with the VelocityOne Flight system , featuring Hall-Effect sensors in critical flight controls where precision and reliability are paramount. Elevate Your Competitive Gaming 5-stop Hall-Effect clutch triggers with hair-trigger mode represent the pinnacle of gaming controller technology. These innovations provide measurable competitive advantages through faster response times, enhanced precision, and unwavering reliability that traditional controllers cannot match. Whether you're mastering complex combos, perfecting your aim, or dominating racing circuits, competitive gaming precision triggers transform how you interact with games. The technology eliminates the barriers between your intentions and in-game actions, creating a seamless connection that serious players demand. Professional gamers don't leave performance to chance—they invest in technology that delivers consistent, superior results. Turtle Beach Hall-Effect triggers provide this edge through proven magnetic sensing technology that maintains peak performance throughout thousands of hours of competitive play. Ready to master your game with cutting-edge controller technology? Explore Turtle Beach's complete headset collection alongside precision controllers to create the ultimate competitive gaming setup. Every trigger pull, every input, every victory depends on the tools you choose; make sure they're worthy of your skill. FAQ What are 5-stop Hall-Effect clutch triggers in gaming controllers? 5-stop Hall-Effect clutch triggers use magnetic sensors to detect trigger position without physical contact, offering five adjustable travel distances to optimize trigger response for different game types while eliminating wear and drift. How does hair-trigger mode improve gaming precision? Hair-trigger mode reduces trigger travel distance to as little as 1.5mm compared to standard 6-7mm travel, creating faster trigger response, higher fire rates, and more consistent input timing crucial for competitive gaming. Why are Hall-Effect triggers preferred for competitive play? Hall-Effect triggers never develop drift, maintain perfect calibration indefinitely, offer superior precision, and provide consistent performance throughout millions of actuations—essential for professional gaming reliability. Can 5-stop Hall-Effect triggers reduce input lag? Yes, Hall-Effect sensors eliminate mechanical contact delays and provide instant magnetic field detection, while adjustable trigger stops reduce physical travel distance, combining to minimize input latency significantly. How do clutch triggers affect gameplay responsiveness? Clutch triggers with adjustable stops allow customization of trigger travel distance, enabling faster actuation and reset for improved fire rates, more precise throttle control, and reduced finger fatigue during extended play. What games benefit most from hair-trigger mode? First-person shooters see the greatest benefit for rapid firing, but fighting games gain combo execution precision, racing games improve throttle control, and any competitive title benefits from reduced input latency. Are Hall-Effect triggers better than traditional analog triggers? Yes, Hall-Effect triggers offer superior durability (no drift), better precision (consistent accuracy), longer lifespan (no wear), and consistent performance, while traditional triggers degrade over time through physical contact wear. How does Turtle Beach implement Hall-Effect technology? Turtle Beach integrates Hall-Effect sensors in premium controllers like the Stealth Ultra and Victrix Pro BFG Reloaded, combining magnetic sensing with 5-stop clutch mechanisms, microswitches, and comprehensive customization software for professional-grade performance.

title: DocGo Acquires Virtual Care Platform SteadyMD, Expands Telehealth Services Across all 50 States
body_text: Strategic Acquisition Combines DocGo’s Last Mile Healthcare Delivery Capabilities With SteadyMD’s Virtual Care Platform; SteadyMD Is Expected To Generate Approximately $25 Million in Revenue in 2025* NEW YORK, NY , October 20, 2025 – DocGo Inc. (Nasdaq: DCGO) (“DocGo” or the “Company”), a leading provider of technology-enabled mobile health and medical transportation services, today announced that it has acquired virtual care platform SteadyMD, Inc. Management will host a conference call and webcast on Tuesday October 21st at 11:00 a.m. ET to discuss this acquisition. SteadyMD powers high-quality telehealth experiences for digital health companies, labs, pharmacies, employers, and other healthcare innovators. The company offers a 50-state virtual clinician workforce, clinical operations, and world-class technology that powers real-time matching between patient needs and clinical expertise. SteadyMD provides virtual care for top consumer, healthcare and digital wellness brands, including multiple Fortune 10 customers. SteadyMD is expected to service over 3 million patients in 2025, and maintains a roster of over 600 clinicians. SteadyMD’s scaled network of virtual providers will enable DocGo to achieve more efficient delivery of patient care, by pairing its mobile health clinicians in the field with SteadyMD’s clinical network. In 2025, SteadyMD is expected to generate approximately $25 million in revenue and is expected to be EBITDA positive for 2026*. The Company plans to update 2025 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance to reflect the transaction as part of its upcoming earnings release and call, which is expected to be held in early November. Guy Friedman, CEO and Co-Founder of SteadyMD, and Yarone Goren, COO and Co-Founder of SteadyMD, are joining the DocGo leadership team upon the close of the transaction. Lee Bienstock, CEO of DocGo commented, “This acquisition marks an exciting milestone in DocGo’s mission to make high-quality, technology-powered healthcare more accessible. SteadyMD has an impressive reputation and has built a proprietary platform that optimizes the delivery of trusted, scalable virtual care services across all 50 states. By combining SteadyMD’s nationwide virtual care platform with our mobile health services and infrastructure, we can provide our enviable roster of customers with an even more comprehensive platform of last mile care, and help realize our goal of providing patients with healthcare at any address. DocGo will continue to seek additional opportunities for acquisitions and partnerships that expand our capabilities and scale while enhancing shareholder value.” Guy Friedman, CEO and Co-Founder of SteadyMD also commented, “Joining forces with DocGo provides us with the resources to extend our vision of providing a more personalized, patient-centered approach to virtual care at an even larger scale. We are excited to work together to improve access, outcomes and convenience for millions of patients.” The company expects to fund the transaction through existing cash on its balance sheet. TD Securities (USA) LLC served as exclusive financial advisor to DocGo, Polsinelli served as legal advisor for DocGo, and Alvarez & Marsal Transaction Advisory Group, Life Sciences, and Global Transaction Tax provided additional due diligence and strategic consulting services. Goodwin Procter LLP served as legal advisor for SteadyMD. Conference Call and Webcast Details Tuesday October 21, 2025 at 11:00 AM ET Webcast: https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1739677&tp_key=1f035a2246 The webcast can also be accessed under Events on the Investors section of the Company’s website, https://ir.docgo.com/ . Presentation materials will be posted on the Company’s IR website immediately prior to the scheduled conference call and webcast. About DocGo DocGo is leading the proactive healthcare revolution with an innovative care delivery platform that includes mobile health services, remote patient monitoring and ambulance services. DocGo is helping to reshape the traditional four-wall healthcare system by providing high quality, highly accessible care to patients where and when they need it. DocGo’s proprietary technology and relationships with a dedicated field staff of certified health professionals elevate the quality of patient care and drive business efficiencies for municipalities, hospital networks and health insurance providers. With Mobile Health, DocGo empowers the full promise and potential of telehealth by facilitating healthcare treatment, in tandem with a remote advanced practice provider, in the comfort of a patient’s home or workplace. Together with DocGo’s integrated Ambulnz medical transport services, DocGo is bridging the gap between physical and virtual care. For more information, please visit www.docgo.com . To get an inside look on how the proactive healthcare revolution is helping transform healthcare by reducing costs, increasing efficiency and improving outcomes, visit www.proactivecarenow.com . summary: Richmond, VA, October 30, 2025 - The Board of Directors of NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) declared a quarterly dividend in the amount of $3.00 per share on the common stock of the Corporation, an increase of $0.25 as compared to the last quarterly dividend of $2.75 per share.
body_text: Richmond, VA, October 30, 2025 – The Board of Directors of NewMarket Corporation (NYSE: NEU) declared a quarterly dividend in the amount of $3.00 per share on the common stock of the Corporation, an increase of $0.25 as compared to the last quarterly dividend of $2.75 per share. The increase represents an approximate 9% increase over the current dividend. The dividend is payable January 2, 2026, to NewMarket shareholders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2025. NewMarket Corporation is a holding company operating through its subsidiaries, Afton Chemical Corporation (Afton), Ethyl Corporation (Ethyl), American Pacific Corporation (AMPAC) and Calca Solutions, LLC (Calca). The Afton and Ethyl companies develop, manufacture, blend, and deliver chemical additives that enhance the performance of petroleum products. AMPAC is a manufacturer of specialty materials primarily used in solid rocket motors for the aerospace and defense industries. Calca is the nation’s leading producer of UltraPure and high-purity hydrazine – essential, mission-critical propellants that enable advanced aerospace and defense applications.The NewMarket family of companies has a long-term commitment to its people, to safety, to providing innovative solutions for its customers, and to making the world a better place. body_text: ORLANDO, Fla., Oct. 27, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Nutriband Inc. (NASDAQ:NTRB)(NASDAQ:NTRBW) has announced that Company founder, Gareth Sheridan has returned as Company CEO. During the period of August 10 until October 27 , Co-Founder and Chairman, Serguei Melnik had taken over the responsibilities of CEO. Mr Sheridan has returned to the position of CEO effective immediately and will guide the company through the final 2025 framework towards the target NDA filing in 2026 for AVERSA Fentanyl. AVERSA FENTANYL has the potential to be the world’s first abuse-deterrent opioid patch designed to deter the abuse and misuse and reduce the risk of accidental exposure of transdermal fentanyl patches. AVERSA FENTANYL has the potential to reach peak annual US sales of $80 million to $200 million. 1 While initially concentrating on the US market, the unmet medical need for adequate pain management is a global problem, and our goal is to make AVERSA FENTANYL available in all major medical markets in the world. The AVERSA™ abuse deterrent technology is protected by a broad international intellectual property portfolio with patents issued in 46 countries including the United States, Europe, Japan, Korea, Russia, China, Canada, Mexico, and Australia. 1 Health Advances Aversa Fentanyl market analysis report 2022 About AVERSA™ Abuse-Deterrent Transdermal Technology Nutriband's AVERSA™ abuse-deterrent transdermal technology incorporates aversive agents into transdermal patches to prevent the abuse, diversion, misuse, and accidental exposure of drugs with abuse potential. The AVERSA™ abuse-deterrent technology has the potential to improve the safety profile of transdermal drugs susceptible to abuse, such as fentanyl, while making sure that these drugs remain accessible to those patients who really need them. The technology is covered by a broad intellectual property portfolio with patents granted in the United States, Europe, Japan, Korea, Russia, China, Canada, Mexico, and Australia. About Nutriband Inc. We are primarily engaged in the development of a portfolio of transdermal pharmaceutical products. Our lead product under development is an abuse-deterrent fentanyl patch incorporating our AVERSA™ abuse-deterrent technology. AVERSA™ technology can be incorporated into any transdermal patch to prevent the abuse, misuse, diversion, and accidental exposure of drugs with abuse potential. title: Snapchat at Advertising Week New York 2025 – Enter the Chat
summary: While other platforms fight for attention in an endless scroll - as the second most preferred platform for consumers globally - Snapchat is where real conversations happen between close friends and family.
body_text: This year at Advertising Week, Snap is putting our most unique space - Chat - front and center. While other platforms fight for attention in an endless scroll - as the second most preferred platform for consumers globally 1 - Snapchat is where real conversations happen between close friends and family. It’s intimate, authentic, and trusted; and now, with Sponsored Snaps, brands can join those moments in a way that feels native, not noisy. This is the new era of connection, and we’re bringing it to life at Advertising Week. The Power of Chat In partnership with MAGNA Media Trials, we explored how and why chat has become the most valuable space for brands, and the findings make it clear why a dedicated chat strategy is essential. Our research shows that people are not only comfortable connecting with friends in chat – they’re also open to hearing from brands there. In fact, 86% of social media users in the U.S. are open to getting messages from brands on apps like Snapchat, Messenger, and others 2 – a signal that chat has become a space for meaningful engagement. On Snapchat, the conversations our community is having are unlike anywhere else – they’re spontaneous, playful, and personal. 71% of Snapchatters say they have their own unique language with friends on the app 3 , underscoring just how intimate and authentic our platform is. For brands, this creates new ways to show up in conversations that already feel trusted and personal. Our research also shows that people want real value when engaging with brands in chat. It’s not enough to just be present – your message needs to matter. Utility comes first - with discounts, personalized recommendations, and timely updates 4 topping the list, while fun, feel-good content can turn a simple interaction into a moment people actually remember. In chat, brands have a unique opportunity to be useful, entertaining, and culturally relevant all at once, showing up in a way that feels less like advertising and more like a Snapchatter. Sponsored Snaps Results – From Conversations to Conversions Across industries, brands are using Sponsored Snaps to reach audiences in ways that feel fresh, timely, and fun. Calvin Harris was the first artist to tap into Sponsored Snaps to promote his single Blessings. The campaign reached 11.8 million Snapchatters in the UK and drove a 58% lift in Spotify streams. With a playful “Calvin Harris is typing…” message, the creative spread quickly beyond Snapchat across other social platforms. According to a study from Kantar , approximately 85% of Snapchatters feel that Sponsored Snaps are "relevant to me", and "fit in with my habits on platform” 5 – proof that ads on Snapchat don’t interrupt the experience, they blend into it. Wendy’s demonstrated just how well a Sponsored Snap can resonate with its audience by staying true to the brand’s voice while mimicking the kind of Snap you might receive from a friend. In just one day, Wendy’s delivered 52 million impressions and saw a 54% spike in organic follower growth, showing the power of meeting audiences in a space where they’re not just receptive to brands, but actually open to hearing from them. Sponsored Snaps have proven to be one of the most effective ways for brands to join the conversation: when Snapchatters fully engage with a Sponsored Snap by opening to the full-screen ad, we see 2.3x more lift in Unaided Brand Awareness, 1.4x more lift in Ad Awareness, and 1.8x more lift in Purchase Intent than other social platforms. 6 By giving brands the power to meet people where they’re engaging regularly with friends, their messages feel personal, relevant, and immediate – making it the perfect place to spark real connection, build relevance, and drive real business outcomes. Sponsored Snaps at Advertising Week Snap will take over Advertising Week with a bold out-of-home campaign highlighting Sponsored Snaps, demonstrating for attendees how brands can become part of the moment – not an interruption. On stage, we’ll showcase how Snapchat is leading the shift from passive scrolling to active engagement. From a mainstage panel with Love Island stars Nic Vansteenberghe and Jeremiah Brown on how chat is reshaping relationships, to a Creator Stage session unpacking research-driven insights and the power of creator partnerships, we’ll demonstrate why brands need a chat strategy today. We’ll also introduce our new Measurement Playbook and join partners in dynamic discussions throughout the week, bringing Snap’s performance and cultural impact to life. We’re not just talking about the future of advertising - we’re bringing it to life. Sponsored Snaps are here, and it’s time for brands to enter the chat.
